hero.title: Fast, secure hosting built for your website
hero.lead: {site} gives you the server, the domain and the control panel in one place. Accounts are provisioned automatically, billing is transparent, and there is a real person on the other end of every ticket.

plans.title: Plans that grow with your website
plans.lead: Every plan runs on the same platform. Start where you are and move up when you need to — your account moves with you.
plans.emptyHint: Nothing is wrong with your account — the catalogue is not answering right now. Please try again shortly.

comparison.title: What each plan includes
comparison.lead: Every line below comes from the plan's own specification.
comparison.scrollHint: Scroll sideways to see every plan.

why.title: Why choose {site}?
why.lead: One account for the whole stack, and no surprises in it.
why.performanceBody: Accounts are placed on servers your provider chooses and sizes, so a busy site is not sharing with the whole catalogue.
why.securityBody: SSL on every site, two-factor sign-in on every account, and an audit trail behind every administrative action.
why.managementBody: Sites, domains, mailboxes, databases and invoices all live in one client area rather than four different logins.
why.automationBody: Orders are provisioned by the platform the moment payment clears — no waiting for someone to set your account up by hand.
why.developersBody: Full control-panel access, databases you create yourself, and a documented API behind the whole platform.
why.supportBody: Tickets are answered by people who can see your account.

performance.title: Built to stay fast as you grow
performance.lead: Only what this platform actually runs — nothing here is a slogan.
performance.storageBody: Your files sit on solid-state storage, so database queries and file reads are not waiting on a disk to spin.
performance.cachingBody: Pages are served from cache where they can be, cutting the work a request makes it all the way through to.
performance.cdnBody: Static files are served from the edge, so a visitor far from the server still gets them quickly.
performance.serversBody: Your provider decides which server an account lands on, so capacity is planned rather than discovered.
performance.scalingBody: Move to a larger plan from the client area and keep the same account, the same domain and the same data.

security.title: Security that is on by default
security.lead: Not an upsell, and not something you have to remember to turn on.
security.sslBody: Every site is served over HTTPS, and certificates are issued and renewed without you filing a ticket.
security.accountBody: Two-factor authentication on sign-in, and every administrative action written to an audit log.
security.isolationBody: Each hosting account gets its own control-panel user, files and databases — neighbours cannot read yours.
security.backupsBody: Your site is backed up on a schedule, and a snapshot can be restored without losing the rest of the day.
security.firewallBody: Traffic is filtered before it reaches your site, and repeat offenders are blocked at the edge.
security.malwareBody: Files are scanned for known malware, and anything found is quarantined rather than quietly left in place.
security.ddosBody: Floods of junk traffic are absorbed before they reach your site, so real visitors keep getting through.

dashboard.title: Everything about your site, in one place
dashboard.lead: Domains, files, databases, certificates and mailboxes are all managed from the same client area — no second login, no separate billing portal.

migration.title: Move your website to {site}
migration.lead: You do not have to rebuild anything. Send us what you have and we will move it, then tell you before we switch anything over.
migration.step1Body: Pick the plan that fits the site you are moving. If you are unsure, ask first — we would rather size it correctly.
migration.step2Body: Open a ticket with your current host's details, or upload an archive of the site and its database.
migration.step3Body: We copy the files, the database and the mailboxes, then check the copy on a test address before anything changes.
migration.step4Body: We move the DNS at a time you choose and stay with it until the site is answering from the new server.

useCases.title: Built for whatever you are launching
useCases.personalBody: A portfolio, a blog or a CV that needs a domain, a certificate and somewhere reliable to live.
useCases.businessBody: A company site with real mailboxes on your own domain, and invoices you can hand to your accountant.
useCases.wordpressBody: PHP, MySQL and the control-panel access WordPress expects, with the certificate already in place.
useCases.ecommerceBody: A shop that needs HTTPS on every page, room to grow, and a plan you can move up mid-season.
useCases.agenciesBody: Several client sites under one account, each with its own domain, mailboxes and billing line.
useCases.developersBody: Databases you create yourself, full control-panel access, and a documented API behind all of it.

guarantees.title: Try it without worry
guarantees.lead: What we promise, in plain words.
guarantees.freeMigrationBody: We move your existing site over for you, at no charge.
guarantees.moneyBackBody: Not happy? Ask for a refund within {days} days of your order.
guarantees.noHiddenFeesBody: The price you see is the price you pay. No surprise charges at checkout or at renewal.

support.title: Help when you need it
support.lead: Reach us the way that suits you.
support.chatBody: Ask a quick question and get an answer while you are still on the page.
support.ticketBody: Describe the problem in detail and follow the conversation from your client area.
support.emailBody: Write to us any time and we will reply to your inbox.
support.phoneBody: Talk to a person about anything that is hard to explain in writing.
